captions.instagram:
Hello from Cairo. We're AmA Studio, and AmA stands for AmAzing.
We make small, bright games for everyday breaks. Easy to learn in a minute, fun for months.
Our first game is on its way. Follow to see it first.

أهلاً من القاهرة إحنا AmA Studio.
بنعمل ألعاب صغيرة ومبهجة لاستراحتك اليومية. أول لعبة جاية قريب، تابعنا علشان تشوفها الأول.

captions.linkedin:
AmA Studio is open.

We're a game studio based in Cairo, Egypt, making small, bright games for everyday breaks: easy to learn in a minute, fun for months. Built in Unity and tested until they feel just right.

Our first game, Kinfold, is on its way. Follow the page for the launch, and say hi if you're a player, press or a partner.

https://amastudios.net/
